lights_add.name: SANSI 80 W folding bulb
lights_add.power: Screws into an E26 socket (120 V); the cord or fixture is not included
lights_add.timer: Remote: 4, 8 or 12 hours. Settings are lost after a power cut.
lights_add.size: 17 in across with the wings open
lights_add.photo_alt: The SANSI 80 W bulb seen from below: four wings of three round LED pods each, 17 inches across
lights_add.chart_alt: Maker's chart: PPFD 720.9 at 1 ft, 331.3 at 2 ft, 163.3 at 3 ft and 94.6 at 4 ft

lights_add.name: SANSI tripod floor light (88 LEDs)
lights_add.kind: Floor stand with a gooseneck head
lights_add.power: Plugs into an outlet; 58 in cord
lights_add.timer: Remote: 4, 8 or 12 hours. Reset the timer after a power cut.
lights_add.size: Stand 33 to 58 in tall; head 4 by 5 in, turns 330°
lights_add.photo_alt: The SANSI tripod light: a black telescopic tripod stand with a gooseneck and a small square LED panel on top
lights_add.chart_alt: Maker's chart: PPFD 719.41 at 1 ft, 233.57 at 2 ft, 106.4 at 3 ft and 52.39 at 4 ft

lights_add.name: SANSI 4-head gooseneck clamp light
lights_add.kind: Clamp light with four gooseneck heads
lights_add.power: Plugs into an outlet; 6 ft cord. Each head holds a replaceable 10 W PAR20 bulb (E26, 10 W at most).
lights_add.size: Goosenecks 15.8 in; clamp opens about 2 in
lights_add.ppfd_note: The maker's figures are with all four heads aimed at one spot, and look generous next to SANSI's own 10 W bulb figures. Aim the heads apart to light more plants, less brightly.
lights_add.photo_alt: The SANSI gooseneck light: a black clamp with four long goosenecks, each ending in a white bulb
lights_add.chart_alt: Maker's chart: PPFD 2496 at 6 in, 804 at 12 in and 480 at 18 in

lights_add.name: SANSI 30 W bulb (PAR25)
lights_add.power: Screws into an E26 socket (120 V). Not dimmable.
lights_add.ppfd_note: 40 white and 10 deep red (660 nm) LEDs. One line of the listing says 220 PPFD at 1 ft; its chart and text say 336.
lights_add.photo_alt: The SANSI 30 W bulb: a white finned PAR25 bulb with a screw base
lights_add.chart_alt: Maker's chart: PPFD 336 at 1 ft, 99 at 2 ft, 44 at 3 ft and 24 at 4 ft, in a 60 degree beam

lights_add.name: Barrina 2 ft standing light
lights_add.kind: Upright tube on a base (lights sideways)
lights_add.power: Plugs into an outlet; 4.9 ft cord with an on/off switch
lights_add.size: 24 in tall tube on a 5 in base; can also hang (2 clips)
lights_add.ppfd_note: Measured sideways from the tube. Warm white with deep red (660 nm) LEDs, up to 75 LEDs.
lights_add.photo_alt: The Barrina standing light: a 24 inch clear tube of LEDs standing upright on a round black base
lights_add.chart_alt: Maker's chart: PPFD 129.14 at 7.87 in, 80.19 at 11.81 in and 39.38 at 15.75 in to the side

lights_add.name: GooingTop 2-bar clip light
lights_add.kind: Clamp light with two LED bars
lights_add.timer: Repeats every day: 4, 8 or 12 hours on
lights_add.ppfd_note: The maker gives no PPFD. These are Claude's estimates for about 10 W of LEDs (74 white, 10 red).
lights_add.photo_alt: The GooingTop light: two black LED bars on goosenecks from one clamp, with its timer controller

lights_add.name: SANSI 10 W bulb (PAR20)
lights_add.power: Screws into an E26 socket (90 to 132 V)
lights_add.photo_alt: The SANSI 10 W bulb taken apart: lens, a ring of LED chips, ceramic board, finned body and screw base
lights_add.chart_alt: Maker's chart: PPFD 97.91 at 1 ft, 24.48 at 2 ft, 10.88 at 3 ft and 6.12 at 4 ft, in a 60 degree beam

lights_add.name: Barrina 1 ft T5 strips, bank of 4
lights_add.kind: Strip lights: 8 strips, used as 2 banks of 4
lights_add.power: Plugs into an outlet; 4 cords with switches and 7 linking cables for the 8 strips (5 W each)
lights_add.timer: On/off switch on each strip, no timer
lights_add.size: Each strip 1 ft long, black; magnets, clips or cable ties
lights_add.ppfd_note: The maker gives no PPFD, only heights: 12 to 14 in for leafy growth, 8 to 12 in for flowering, strips about 4 in apart. These are Claude's estimates for a bank of four strips 4 in apart under a shelf; one strip alone gives roughly a third as much.
lights_add.photo_alt: Two black Barrina T5 strips mounted under a shelf, each with its own on/off switch, over a begonia
lights_add.chart_alt: Maker's height guide: 11.8 to 13.8 in for seedlings and leafy growth, 7.9 to 11.8 in for flowering, strips 3.93 in apart

lights_add.name: SANSI 2 ft T8 strip set
lights_add.power: Plugs into an outlet; 6 ft cord. Splash-proof (IP54).
lights_add.timer: Repeats every day: 4, 8 or 12 hours on
lights_add.ppfd_note: The maker's figures. Claude does not know yet how many strips the set has or their watts.
lights_add.photo_alt: A SANSI T8 strip lit up under a shelf, with water spraying on it to show it is splash-proof
lights_add.chart_alt: Maker's chart: PPFD 37.9 at 1 ft, 12.1 at 2 ft, 5.7 at 3 ft and 3.3 at 4 ft

lights_add.name: SANSI pot clip light
lights_add.kind: Small light that clips to a pot
lights_add.power: USB (5 V): a phone charger, power bank or computer; 78.7 in cord
lights_add.timer: Repeats every day: 3, 6 or 12 hours on
lights_add.size: 12.8 in gooseneck; clips onto a rim up to 0.8 in thick
lights_add.ppfd_note: The maker gives one figure, 35.78 at 6 in.
lights_add.photo_alt: The SANSI pot clip light: a small round white head on a white gooseneck, clipped to a square pot

lights_add.name: Commercial Electric disk light
lights_add.kind: Ceiling disk light (a room light, not a grow light)
lights_add.power: Wired in or on a lamp cord (120 V)
lights_add.ppfd_note: A room light, so there is no PPFD from the maker. Claude's estimate from its 800 lumens, warm white and wide beam: fine for plants that need little light, close up.

requests_add.text: Grow lights: which lamps or clamp sockets do the six SANSI 10 W bulbs, the two 30 W bulbs and the 80 W bulb screw into, and are any of the 10 W bulbs the ones in the 4-head gooseneck? Put it under "Where it is" on the Grow lights page, or tell Claude.
Grow lights: how many strips are in the SANSI 2 ft T8 set, and how many watts is each (on the strip or its box)?
Grow lights: where is the Commercial Electric disk light: in a ceiling, a lamp or under a shelf, and about how far above the plants?
Grow lights: where inside will the plants go (rooms, shelves, windows), and which of your lights are already set up there? The Grow lights page suggests a layout you can set up with one press each.
